method: Chrome ChatGPT.com: master, then two UI forks from the master reply before layer requests. Original used for BG, forks for MG and FG.
bounds_note: Approximate visual coordinates; exact master silhouette takes priority. Bounds are not a command to rescale.

checks.static_composite: ChatGPT self-review on reduced preview: suitable as workflow trial, not production-final. Differences in carpet, chair/foot overlap and shadows. No pixel-perfect claim.
checks.bbox_test: Global scale/position improved; internal geometry does not match sufficiently for strict master reconstruction.

method_detail: Initial generated layers were not reliably registered. ChatGPT subsequently supplied processed PNG masks/files. MG and FG final PNGs are full-canvas alpha layers; BG is opaque. Production image processing was performed in ChatGPT.com. Local Pillow used for objective checks, zero-offset diagnostic composite, and the explicitly proposed bbox algorithm test.

additional_test.description: Uniform scale and translation of first generated MG, per user proposal and separate ChatGPT Extra High analysis
additional_test.review: ChatGPT visual self-review: global alignment improved, internal geometry still differs; unsuitable for strict master reconstruction.
